Hi — I've pulled together four incoming task requests from our stakeholders (they're in the `requests/` folder as JSON files). Before the engineering team touches any of them, I need a structured pre-execution analysis document that our tech lead can review.

We have context about my goals and the current project state in the workspace. For each of the four requests, I need you to figure out:
- Whether the request is ready to act on, needs more information, or has some other problem
- What I actually want to achieve (not just what I literally said)
- Whether anything could go wrong before we commit irreversible work
- Whether any of these align with goals we said we cared about but have let go stale

Please save your full analysis as `analysis_report.json` in the workspace.
